description: Decode English quotations in a quiet offline puzzle game.
storageWarning: Progress can’t be saved. Keep this tab open.
patternHelp: Each number stands for one letter. A few letters are already revealed.
guessHelp: Select a number, then a letter. Every matching number updates together. Selection moves to the next blank on the right, wrapping at the end. Each letter can belong to only one number.
checkHelp: Guesses stay neutral. Check highlights mistakes, Hint reveals one letter, and undo works for both guesses and hints. While checked mistakes are highlighted, Erase clears one marked assignment and focuses its cell. Other marks remain until you edit or check again.
typingHelp: Enter a letter; non-Latin layouts use English key positions
nextBlank: Next blank, wrapping at the end
tabHelp: Move between the board and controls
privacy: No accounts or tracking. Progress stays on this device.
revealDescription: Reveal number {number} everywhere in the quote. You can undo this hint.
restartDescription: Clear guesses, hints and move history. Starting clues will stay.
boardDescription: Arrow keys move between editable letters. Type A to Z to enter a guess. Backspace erases.
layoutHelp: Use the English layout or the on-screen keys.
selectFirst: Select a number in the quote first.
clueLocked: This letter is a revealed clue.
useAlphabet: Use a letter from A to Z.
duplicate: {letter} is already assigned to number {symbol}. Erase it there first.
selectPrompt: Select a number, then enter a letter.
hintRevealed: Number {number} is {letter}. Hint revealed; undo is available.
checkMistakes: Assignments to revisit: {count}. Marked with a dot.
checkGood: Your entered letters look good. Keep going.
checkEmpty: No guesses to check yet. Try a letter first.
allFilled: Every number has a letter. You can check your guesses.
saveFailure: Your latest move could not be saved. Keep playing and try again later.
activationFailure: The update could not finish. Your progress is safe. Please retry.
updateReady: A new version is downloaded and ready.
offlineUpdate: You’re offline. You can keep playing and read these notes.
unavailableUpdate: Update checks are unavailable here. Open the installed app or production website.
failedUpdate: Could not check for updates. Please try again later.
quietUpdates: Updates are checked quietly when you return to CODE.
